supporting_observations.claim: The alerted outbound activity is associated with update.stockpilot.co, whereas the inventory identifies the approved StockPilot update host as update.stockpilot.com. The logged hostname differs by its top-level domain.

The updater making these connections ran from Eli Brooks's AppData\Local directory, not the inventory's approved C:\Program Files\StockPilot path. It also generated a file-creation event for its own executable path.

Connections to the mismatched update.stockpilot.co hostname recur at roughly five-minute intervals from 13:39 through 14:09 UTC, and endpoint telemetry attributes the proxy connections to the AppData StockPilot updater process.
One attempt to reach update.stockpilot.co was denied by the proxy; other recorded attempts received status 200. The differing outcomes do not establish what content was exchanged.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT metadata and byte counts, but do not establish the contents or purpose of the TLS traffic.
The provided records do not include a file hash, signature validation, or reputation assessment for the updater executable.
The logs show the updater process associated with proxy connections, but do not establish who installed or modified the executable.
claims_not_established: Whether update.stockpilot.co is malicious or controlled by an unauthorized party.
Whether the AppData executable is a tampered or unauthorized copy of the legitimate StockPilot updater.
What data, if any, was sent to or received from the remote endpoint.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire and analyze the updater executable; record its hash, signature, creation and modification history, and compare it with a trusted StockPilot copy.
Check DNS, certificate, domain-registration, and threat-intelligence data for update.stockpilot.co and compare it with the approved update.stockpilot.com service.
Obtain proxy or endpoint TLS inspection and application-level records, if available, for the connections to determine their content and destination.
Confirm with the software owner whether the AppData installation path or update.stockpilot.co hostname is authorized.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect vpnagent.exe ran on WS-EBROOKS-01, despite the inventory stating there is no VPN. The record shows process execution only, not a VPN connection; investigate separately. (T185-00252, T185-00253)
